title: [review] project-LICHEN-6mij: lichen_coap_oscore_respond doc says ctx may be NULL but annotation says _Nonnull
description:
The doxygen comment for lichen_coap_oscore_respond in coap_oscore.h:127 says '@param[in] ctx OSCORE security context (may be NULL)' but the declaration at line 136 annotates ctx as _Nonnull. The implementation doesn't handle NULL ctx — it passes it straight to coap_oscore_protect_response which also expects non-NULL. The doc and annotation are inconsistent.

Fix: update the doc to say '(must be non-NULL)' or remove the '(may be NULL)' qualifier.
